content:
maria (oncall): seeing a sharp uptick in 504s for hosted inference routes, started ~09:12 UTC, ~25-30% error rate on /v1/generate for last 10m. dashboards: https://console/redwood/alerts/heap
lee (support): got ~15+ customer reports in the last 12m, some mention repeat timeouts then success on retry
svc-monitor: ALERT: hosted-gateway latency_p50 > 600ms and 504_rate > 20% for 10m
maria (oncall): adding logs — gateway logs show lots of upstream connection resets and "no healthy upstream" lines
jonathan (infra): I just pushed a global gateway config tweak 09:05 UTC (keepalive=15s, max_conn=200). Could be related
sam (sre): can we scale the gateway pool now? trying to confirm if connection pool exhaustion
jonathan (infra): scaling gateway nodes +2 now (autoscale had limits due to quota), also reverting keepalive change to previous 60s as a quick rollback
deploy-bot: Revert config commit: git@repo:infra/gateway#commit-9f3a — queued
maria (oncall): repro steps I'm using if helpful:
```
for i in {1..300}; do curl -s -w "%{http_code}\n" -o /dev/null -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"prompt":"hi","max_tokens":5}' https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate &
done
```
observed ~25% 504 under that parallel load on gateway
sam (sre): logs from a gateway instance: "upstream connect error or disconnect/reset before headers", connection pool saturated, backend (inference nodes) healthy
lee (support): some customers also hit 401 then 504 in same session — think retries + auth proxy hitting bursts
jonathan (infra): mitigation status: reverted keepalive config, scaled +2 gateways, increased connection pool config on backends temporarily. Early metrics look better: 504_rate down to 4% in last 8m
maria (oncall): good — keep watching for 30m. let's collect root cause notes and action items here
sam (sre): preliminary cause: aggressive keepalive change reduced time connections were reused, causing more churn and pool exhaustion under bursty client retries. also autoscaler throttle slowed node add. sequencing issue
lee (support): creating a customer-facing note: short blurb + status page update (holding) — I'll draft and share
jonathan (infra): action items:
- infra: add pre-deploy canary and gate for gateway config changes (owner: jonathan) — due 2024-07-29
- infra/sre: improve autoscaler soft limits and add emergency spin-up path (owner: sam) — due 2024-08-05
- devex: add guidance for SDK retry backoff defaults to reduce thundering retries (owner: maria) — due 2024-07-31
- infra: add a CI lint to prevent keepalive below 30s without explicit approval (owner: jonathan) — due 2024-07-29
- support: send customer update and collect impact list (owner: lee) — due 2024-07-25
maria (oncall): I'll draft incident summary + attach logs and graphs, want an action items doc for postmortem later
sam (sre): note for postmortem: collect gateway connection metrics, pool sizing history, deploy timeline with commit ids, and autoscaler activity
lee (support): flagged top 6 enterprise customers to PMs, will escalate for SLA credits if needed
maria (oncall): closing war room for now — 504s under control. follow-up postmortem in #incidents later today. thanks all :thumbsup:
